title: The People's Confession of Sin under Nehemiah
description: After the reading of the Law, the people of Israel gathered in mourning and fasting. The Levites led a great prayer in which they praised God as Creator, remembered His faithfulness from Abraham through the Exodus and the wilderness journey, confessed the people's repeated rebellion, and acknowledged that they were now slaves in their own land because of their sins.
